verdict.rationale: Sardine documents a Case Management workspace for conducting investigations and resolving cases, and audit-ready agents for AML investigations. This implies an investigation record exists. However, no evidence explicitly shows analysts attaching evidence, writing notes, or recording decision reasons in a case history. missing for 10: explicit documentation of note-taking, evidence attachment, and decision-reason capture in the investigation history, an audit trail or timeline view, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a risk-analyst, I can record evidence, notes and decision reasons in the investigation history

citations.quote: Case Management: Unified workspace to review alerts, conduct investigations, and resolve cases.
Agentic AML Ops: Automate KYC/AML alert reviews and speed up investigations with audit-ready agents.
